feeds.title: Mark Piggott - Fantasy and Steampunk Author
feeds.description: Steampunk meets the Wild West in my corner of the web! Mark Piggott likes to spin tales of aether-powered revolvers, clockwork trains, and fantastical adventures beyond the dusty plains. Join me for genre explorations, writing tips, character insights, and lively discussions.

feeds.title: The Passing Place » Steampunk
feeds.description: Dive into The Passing Place's treasure trove of steampunk book reviews! Uncover hidden gears, unearth genre gems, and find your next steam-powered adventure. The Passing Place enumerates the writings and stories from Mark Hayes, a Yorkshire-born novelist with a fad for Music, Star Wars, Batman, Doctor Who, Steampunk, and other things.

feeds.title: Mist Glen Moon » Steampunk
feeds.description: Jenna Eatough is a well-known Science Fiction and Fantasy Author. Delve into the cogs and gears of imagination with her Steampunk collection, where the Victorian era gets a delightful twist of steam-powered wonders and clockwork marvels.

feeds.title: David Lee Summers' Web Journal » Steampunk
feeds.description: Read articles dissecting the latest Steampunk novels, graphic novels, and even the occasional novella. David Lee Summers is an author, editor, and astronomer living somewhere between the western and final frontiers in Southern New Mexico. His blog chronicles his newest projects and activities including writing and other stuff.

feeds.title: Maita Rue
feeds.description: Step into the fantastical realm of steampunk, where Victorian charm collides with contraptions fueled by steam and imagination. Maita Rue is a multi-faceted and accomplished professional, with a diverse portfolio in the areas of writing, design, teaching, and art. As an author, Maita is known for her imaginative stories that explore a range of genres including Steampunk Victorian, Historical Fantasy, and Paranormal Romance.

feeds.title: Madeleine Holly Rosing Steampunk Blog
feeds.description: Madeleine Holly-Rosing is a TV, feature film, and comic book writer known for books like Boston Metaphysical Society and Other Stories of Fantasy, Science Fiction, and Steampunk. Follow her latest work updates, news, and announcements on the blog.

feeds.title: Jonathan Fesmire Blog
feeds.description: This is Jonathan Fesmire's Steampunk, Science Fiction, and Writing Blog. It covers steampunk and other science fiction, fantasy, and geek interests, as well as writing and art. Dive into the creative process, explore worldbuilding secrets, and witness the sparks fly as story ideas coalesce.

feeds.title: Bookshine And Readbows » Steampunk
feeds.description: Stephanie Warren dissects the intricate machinations of the plot, analyzes the clockwork precision of character development, and judges the fuel efficiency of world-building. Bookshine And Readbows is her blog, an indie little collection of books she finds interesting as well as some random ramblings.

feeds.title: Weatherwax Report Blog » Steampunk
feeds.description: Prepare to embark on a voyage through the captivating realm of Steampunk. The Weatherwax Report reviews dissect and delve into narratives where airships carve paths through smog-filled skies, and clockwork dragons soar above cobbled streets.

feeds.title: Cogpunk Steamscribe
feeds.description: Cogpunk Steamscribe is a writer of both creative non-fiction and Fantasy/Science Fiction based in Queensland, Australia. This blog chronicles their journey into the captivating world of steampunk, occasionally featuring writing excerpts, stories, and personal ramblings.

feeds.title: Steampunk Stuff » Books
feeds.description: Explore ravishing Book reviews and news articles. SteampunkStuff.co.uk is a blog dedicated to sharing our passion for steampunk and providing a platform for others to learn and engage with this fascinating subculture. The creators write and share to make it simple for steampunk enthusiasts to discover and explore some of the best artifacts available online.

feeds.title: Caedar Writing Artwork » Steampunk
feeds.description: Discover a trove of literary treasures as this writer Caedar Writing Artwork journeys through the intricate tapestry of Steampunk, where the past collides with the future in a symphony of brass and imagination. The author D. W. is also certified fitness instructor and an English tutor.

feeds.title: Chanticleer Book Reviews » Steampunk
feeds.description: Discover Steampunk reviews. Prepare to be spellbound by the allure of clockwork marvels and steam-powered wonders as we delve into the captivating world of Steampunk fiction. Chanticleer is a growing publishing company that offers an array of services and tools to authors, which can help authors achieve their publishing goals.
